result.title: Random Feature Pruning for Multi-Class Classification
result.summary: Weighted sums of random kitchen sinks (W-RKS) is a commonly used feature extraction technique for supervised learning tasks. A major drawback of this method is the redundancy and ineffectiveness of many extracted random features. This paper investigates efficient methods for reducing such redundancy in multi-class classification problems. We specifically formulate feature selection as a variant of the sequentially nested model selection problem and introduce the Successive Empirical Excess Risk Difference Maximization (SEED-MAX) algorithm. It recursively computes empirical risks to identify the most parsimonious yet informative set of features. We derive an analytical lower bound for the probability of correct feature selection by the SEED-MAX algorithm. This lower bound on the probability of correct feature selection can be made arbitrarily close to one by increasing the training dataset size. To further enhance the rate of pruning, we evaluate the features retained by SEED-MAX using the Fisher test (F-Test). Empirical evaluations on UCR time-series classification datasets show that the sequential application of SEED-MAX with the Fisher test achieves approximately 92 percent rate of pruning with negligible degradation in classification accuracy. Implementations of the SEED-MAX and SEED-MAX-F-Test methods are available at https://github.com/OmidiAmin/seed-max-ftest.

AI.brief_summary: 论文关注多类分类中随机 kitchen sinks 特征（W-RKS）的冗余与低效问题，将特征选择表述为序贯嵌套模型选择，提出 SEED-MAX 算法递归以经验风险差挑出最简约而具信息量的特征子集，给出正确选择概率的解析下界，并用 Fisher 检验加速剪枝；在 UCR 时序分类数据上约 92% 剪枝率且精度几乎不降。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按序贯准则挑选/剪除特征并给出选择正确性下界」的思路，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、冗余 latent 状态剪枝与停止时机判断提供可核查的方法线索，但领域较远，可迁移性需阅读原文判断。
